items.text: Proposition 122 (the Natural Medicine Health Act, passed in November 2022) decriminalised personal possession and use of psilocybin for adults 21 and over, and set up licensed healing centers where sessions are supervised by a licensed facilitator. Businesses can't sell psilocybin outside that program.
The state issued its first healing center licence in 2025, in Denver.

laws.rule: Adults 21 and over may buy and possess up to 1 ounce at a time from licensed stores. Any public use (smoking, eating or vaping) is illegal, including on sidewalks, in parks, ski resorts, concert venues, businesses, restaurants and bars, and building common areas. Cannabis remains illegal under US federal law, including on federal land such as national parks.

Using cannabis in public is illegal, including on sidewalks, in parks, at ski resorts, concert venues, bars and restaurants. It is also illegal on federal land such as national parks and forests, and taking cannabis out of Colorado or into any airport is illegal.
